newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares gain in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares gain in higher trade.

text.p: Estonian shares gained on Tuesday in higher trade and dealers said they expected the market to remain stable for the next few weeks.
The TALSE index gained 0.61 percent to close at 259.16 and overall market volume rose to 63.9 million kroons from 47 million kroons on Monday.
Forekspank saw trade of 16.96 million kroons to end lower at 180.50 kroons vs 183.25 kroons, a fall which baffled dealers.
"This is a strange trend, because Forekspank was expected to keep rising," one dealer said.
Farmaatsiatehas was the biggest loser on the main list to close at 113.15 kroons versus 116 kroons on Monday in light turnover.

Farmaatsiatehas rose three kroons on Monday after it announced its intention to establish a Russian factory and raised its 1997 profit estimate. Dealers said it may have risen a bit too high too fast.
On the free market, Norma was most active share in trade of 2.35 million kroons to close lower at 73 kroons versus 74 kroons on Monday.
